name: Supriya Lifescience Ltd
summary: Supriya Lifescience Limited researches, develops, makes and sells pharmaceutical chemicals and bulk drugs around the world. Its active pharmaceutical ingredients span the anti-gout, anti-malarial, vitamin, anti-hypertensive, analgesic, decongestant, anti-asthmatic, anti-allergic and antihistamine areas, as well as oncology, veterinary and general products.
